at_sea:
NOTHING AT SEA — ticket watchme-emits-a-probe crossed PROVED at the real door (cairn/tools/base/history.json seq 20, 2026-07-30T15:29:17), both gates journaling clean. Both roots committed and PUSHED, verified by instrument (`python3 -m cairn.tools.orient.orient git`): cairn b525600, CairnCommons e2b0ea7, both HEAD == upstream, 0 ahead, 0 dirty.

WHAT LANDED. LEARNING is DISSOLVED as a node state, not deprecated; WATCHME replaces LEARNME and means 'emits a probe'. code-seam@v2 and skill@v2 are minted with v1 FROZEN beside them (that freeze is why no at-sea node is stranded). The emission gate is the FIFTH seat in emit()'s block (transitions.py:167, WatchmeEmissionRed — a sibling of the other four gate reds, none subclassing another): crossing forward out of a carried WATCHME requires an EMITTED probe — on disk, armed, its trigger/enough/carrier/nexus/consumer spec'd AT TICKETING. Akien's rule is now physics: OPTIONAL TO CARRY, MANDATORY TO SATISFY ONCE CARRIED; 'none, because X' is the only other legal answer and silence is refused in every form measured. Migration rewrites nobody's past — a node migrates when its NEXT journaled crossing names v2, carrying `migrated_from` with the v1 string intact. The feedback contract generalized rather than forking: a verdict's obligations may come from a chart validate berth OR from `falsifier@<ticket-id>`, through ONE validate_verdict (verdict_error gained one check and lost none).

THE CHART IS ANSWERED: 8 criteria run by their instruments, all pass; 13 hypotheses dispositioned, 11 confirmed and 2 KILLED. Two verdict artifacts berthed and deposited into the hypothesize tree (8 nodes from the falsifier-sourced one, 21 from the chart-sourced one, 0 duplicates, pending ledger drained).

(1) THE stage_needs RULING (cheapest, unblocks a standing red). cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_needs.py is RED and has been since before this voyage. Measured cause: across 13 tickets the `stage_needs` key carries TWO vocabularies — 9 use CHART stages (orient, constrain, survey, decompose, triage, hypothesize, validate) and 4 use WORKFLOW stages (BUILDME) — and test_needs enforces only the latter. This is a question about what the KEY MEANS, so it is a ruling, not a patch, and it is another owner's space.

(2) THE at-sea MIGRATION SWEEP. build_inspector still stands at LEARNME on code-seam@v1 under ticket a-voyage-names-its-ticket, which deliberately HOLDS its close; roughly 18 other at-sea tickets have not yet ridden a crossing since v2 was minted. Each migrates by its own owner on its own next crossing — the mechanism is proven, nothing is stuck, but the fleet is mid-transition and that is worth knowing.

(3) THE BEAT. The horizon built this voyage counts PULSES, and nothing pulses cairn/tools/base's shim today — the wall-clock backing is a filed edge. Until it exists, armed-and-never-fired loudness rides BaseShim.overdue() (a read-side door) alone, and _HORIZON=1000 stays a placeholder rather than a measurement.
open_threads: RATIFIED BY MEASUREMENT, not my read — the two KILLED hypotheses are the voyage's most transferable findings. H1: a rename is NEVER behaviour-free in a system that checks refs in the world. This ticket's rename falsified its OWN chart refs BY SUCCEEDING — the WATCHME crossing was refused with five findings naming addresses the ticket's own decompose piece had renamed hours earlier — forcing a new both-ends filter (build_inspector.forwarding_order_resolves, 17 filters -> 18). And the enumerated sweep list was itself incomplete: bus-completion.json's LIVE spec named a renamed class, a renamed method and two renamed files it never mentioned. An enumerated sweep list is a HYPOTHESIS about completeness, not a statement of it.

H4: a precedent transfers on the shape of the CHANGE, not the shape of the ARTIFACT. The skill-class stone had proved 'a version lands in the class file ALONE, zero lines of transitions.py change', and I read that as covering any new version. It did not — WATCHME ROAMS AND NAMES ITS OBJECT, and v1's fixed-position path grammar could not express a free summons, so commit fb03f42 had to teach the parser FREE SUMMONSES. Adding a version is free; adding a GRAMMAR is not.

FIRST LIVE FIRES KEEP CATCHING THEIR BUILDERS, and this one caught two bugs four green proofs had missed — both of them this ticket's own disease. (a) The probe's corpus counted THIS ticket, the node that invented the mechanism, counting its own participation as evidence that authors participate: home-field advantage as a measurement, at n=1, by the maximally motivated author. (b) `enough` had no sample-size floor while `_trigger` required 12, so the watch could CLEAR at n=1 but not FIRE until n=12 — guaranteed to retire before it could ever bite, which is exactly the summons-satisfied-by-nobody failure the probe exists to detect. Either alone was fatal. Both fixed and written into the module.

A PROOF THAT CHECKS NON-VACUITY CAN ITSELF BE VACUOUS. My first per-field drop test iterated `list(watchme.values())` guarded by isinstance(s, dict) — but `watchme` is a FLAT dict of strings, so nothing was popped and every one of the seven fields falsely read 'GREEN (vacuous)'. Caught only by looking at WHY every field passed. Kin to the leak-scan coin-toss-red: the shape of the data under test is itself a thing to measure.

MY READ, not ratified: validate criterion 5's named act was SUBSTITUTED and the substitution is stated in the verdict's evidence rather than hidden. The instrument said 'migrate build_inspector at the real chokepoint'; build_inspector stands at LEARNME under ticket a-voyage-names-its-ticket, whose own cursor note reads 'This stone HOLDS ITS CLOSE here', so migrating it would have closed another ticket's deliberately-held voyage from inside this one (Law 6). The CLAIM was measured two other ways instead: the mechanism in anger on cairn/tools/base (history idx 18, migrated_from intact, pre-migration prefix hash 9e068d1ca50df84a unchanged) and a dry-run at the real door on build_inspector's live string (PROVED is already a legal target from LEARNME on v1, so no no-op self-loop is needed). If Akien reads that as papering over a miss rather than an owner-boundary, the disposition should be revisited.

IOU, TRACKED IN THE PROBE MODULE: nothing pulses cairn/tools/base's shim today, so `record['overdue']` is never produced in anger and the armed-and-never-fired loudness rides BaseShim.overdue() alone; and _HORIZON = 1000 is honest as a placeholder and dishonest as a measurement — it MUST be re-tuned when the beat becomes a real number.

In bus-completion.json, ten LIVE spec pointers were forwarded and Akien's dated 2026-07-25 verbatim ('the callback is the tool. the poke is the act') was left byte-identical, with the forwarding recorded in provenance.
